Mapper nested-property consumers release only these returned pointer temporaries in finally blocks; borrowed Stream.props and existing host-owned OOXML references retain their contracts. RTF materialization uses an actual SwXTextDocument/DomainMapper and real SwPaM ranges; admitted bold, italic, font size, ASCII font, color, underline/color and kerning resource trees reach the original PropertyMap and SetPropertyValues with source insertTextPortion NOFORMATATTR, preserving explicit native item presence instead of a value-difference filter. Original raw style rPr references remain distinct from materialized SwAttrSet ancestry; flattening copies rPr children without following parents. Default style0 insertion, first-entry table insertion and numeric entry order follow source. Parent/follow controls capture currently known source names, preserving empty non-forced RTFValue query zero (WRITER206). Targeted real-owner tests cover later style edits, parent references, script scope and exceptional pointer-return cleanup. Full native parser-property state, style application through native style-table/UNO owners, non-admitted character and paragraph/table property families, replay/substreams, complete script import/export and earlier TXT/RTF/Markdown/HTML obligations remain open. Existing named-style materialization and remaining callbacks are not certified as full upstream contracts; duplicate-ID/name selection is unverified.
